description: This file defines an 'EditorPane' component for a note-taking application using the LightningJS framework. It handles displaying, editing, and deleting notes, along with UI interactions and state management.

classes.name: EditorPane
classes.description: A LightningJS component for editing notes with features like autosave, delete confirmation, and content display.

methods.name: autosave
methods.description: Saves the current note content via the NoteService and updates the last saved timestamp.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets focus to the title input area.

methods.name: focusContent
methods.description: Sets focus to the content input area.

methods.name: $onDelete
methods.description: Triggers the confirmation dialog to delete the current note.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms or cancels the deletion of the note based on user input; performs deletion if confirmed.
